name: Stare Into The Abyss zeroes Corrupt Mind's cast time through a native -100% spell mod (#1981)
contract: 525019 has a single ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effect, Misc=10=SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (SpellDefines.h:86), BasePoints -101+1=-100%, classmask word A bit29 (536870912) matching Corrupt Mind's (560109) own SpellFamilyFlags[0]=536870912 exactly. A second same-named record (561150) has different flags ([0,0,65536]) and is not matched, exercised here as a negative control proving the classmask, not just the name, decides the target. SpellInfo::CalcCastTime (SpellInfo.cpp:2948) calls caster->ModSpellCastTime, the normal engine path that applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME through Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219); the harness's spell_cast_time_ms metric reads this exact function. Both 560109 and 561150 share CastingTimeIndex 16 = 1500 ms (SpellCastTimes.dbc, verified), so the -100% mod deterministically zeroes 560109's cast time while 561150 stays at 1500 ms; Player::ApplySpellMod's SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME clamp is (basevalue+totalflat)*totalmul with totalmul=0, giving exactly 0, not a floor/clamp guess. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
